vibe: Objective, rigid, functional, academic, structural. Exposing the technical skeleton of the UI.

rules.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl tracking-tighter font-medium text-black
rules.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl tracking-tight font-medium text-black

layout_and_spacing.grid_strategy: MODE B: The 'Control Room' Grid. Strict grid hierarchy, dense and compact, functional.
layout_and_spacing.borders: Expose the skeleton. Visible 1px grid borders (border-black/10 or border-border). Sharp edges (rounded-none).
layout_and_spacing.alignment: Left-align dense content. Optical alignment. Generous spacing within containers.
layout_and_spacing.surfaces: Grid Borders (The 'Technical' Look). Use border-collapse style layouts.

components.cards: Flat background, 1px solid border (border-border), no shadow, rounded-none. Hover: border color darkens, slight lift (-translate-y-1), harsh drop shadow like shadow-[4px_4px_0px_#0A0A0A] for a brutalist edge.

buttons.primary: bg-primary text-white hover:bg-primary_hover rounded-none font-medium px-6 py-3 transition-colors
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent border border-black text-black hover:bg-black hover:text-white rounded-none font-medium px-6 py-3 transition-colors
buttons.accent: bg-accent_yellow text-black border border-black rounded-none hover:bg-yellow-400 px-6 py-3 transition-colors

components.inputs: rounded-none border-border focus:border-primary focus:ring-1 focus:ring-primary focus:outline-none
components.navigation: Solid background, hard bottom border. Links with sharp hover states.
components.badges: rounded-none border border-black text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider px-2 py-1 bg-white text-black

icons.style: Regular or Bold weight, sharp, functional. Good for dense dashboards.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use Shadcn UI components but heavily override them to remove all border-radius (rounded-none) and soft shadows. Use sharp 1px borders.
Apply Archetype 4 (Swiss & High-Contrast). Avoid gradients and soft blur. Use solid colors and stark contrasts.
Every key informational and interactive element MUST have a data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='branch-mechanical-card').
Do NOT use HTML <select> or <input type='date'>. Use Shadcn Dropdown, Select, etc.
For the equipment detail view, utilize a strict grid layout displaying Definition, Working Principle, Main Parts, Applications, and Notes. A Bento grid or 'Control Room' grid is preferred.
Implement the layout with pure Tailwind CSS. Maintain a responsive mobile-first approach but utilize grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 for lists.
Header must have a solid background with a 1px border-b. Do NOT use transparent backgrounds for the header.
For hover states on cards, use a brutalist shadow: shadow-[4px_4px_0px_#0A0A0A] and border-black.
Do NOT use 'Inter' for headings. Use Clash Display, imported via Google/Fontshare API in CSS.
Focus heavily on the 'Gen Z Engagement' aspect by employing this brutalist, high-contrast, bold-typography aesthetic instead of a boring generic template.
